content.heading: Year-end support for UK limited companies
content.content:
Every UK limited company must prepare annual accounts and file them with Companies House, and file a Corporation Tax return with HMRC, even if the company made little or no profit. The two are closely linked, so we prepare them together.

We work with:
- Owner-managed limited companies and their directors
- Contractors and consultants trading through their own company
- Small and growing companies with employees
- New companies approaching their first year end

We work entirely online. You share your bookkeeping and bank records digitally, we prepare the accounts and tax return, and you approve both before anything is filed.

content.heading: Year-end deadlines and what we need from you
content.content:
A private limited company normally has nine months after the end of its financial year to file annual accounts with Companies House. Corporation Tax for most small and medium companies is due nine months and one day after the end of the accounting period, and the CT600 return is due twelve months after it.

Corporation Tax is charged at 19% on profits up to £50,000 and 25% on profits over £250,000, with marginal relief in between. Missing a deadline can lead to automatic penalties, so we plan your year end well ahead.

To prepare your accounts we will usually need:
- Access to your bookkeeping or accounting software
- Business bank statements for the full year
- Details of assets bought or sold, loans and director's loan account movements
- Any invoices owed to you, or bills you owed, at the year end

items.question: Do I need to file accounts if my company made no profit?
items.answer: Yes. Every active limited company must file annual accounts and a Corporation Tax return. Dormant companies have simpler requirements, which we can explain.

items.question: When are my annual accounts due?
items.answer: Usually nine months after your company's financial year end for Companies House. We check your exact dates during onboarding and track them for you.

items.question: Can you take over from my previous accountant?
items.answer: Yes. We request the information we need from your previous accountant and pick up from your next year end, or sooner if a filing is due.

items.question: Do you do my bookkeeping as well?
items.answer: Our annual service works from your bookkeeping records. If your records need tidying before year end, mention it when you book and we will quote for it separately.

items.question: Can you help reduce my Corporation Tax?
items.answer: We make sure you claim the allowances and reliefs your company is entitled to, and talk you through options such as pension contributions before your year end.

items.question: How much do annual accounts cost?
items.answer: We quote after a free consultation. The price depends on your company's size, the number of transactions and the quality of your records.

items.question: Do I need to meet you in person?
items.answer: No. We work entirely online: consultations by video call, records shared digitally and accounts approved by you before filing.
